name: StirMark benchmark
description: An automated web-based evaluation service for assessing the robustness and performance of digital watermarking schemes (StirMark).
reputation: A well-known, widely cited benchmark in the digital watermarking community for evaluating robustness of watermarking schemes.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on image/multimedia watermark robustness; hardware/software and attack-model dependent; somewhat dated relative to the latest attacks and steganalysis techniques.
